```python
script_content = '''from collections import Counter
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx")
ws = wb.active
rows = list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))

orders = []
for r in rows:
    orders.append({
        "id": str(r[0]),
        "customer": str(r[1]),
        "date": str(r[2]).split(" ")[0] if r[2] else "",
        "status": str(r[3]),
        "items": str(r[4]),
        "total": int(r[5]) if r[5] else 0,
    })

confirmed = [o for o in orders if o["status"] == "confirmed"]
cancelled = [o for o in orders if o["status"] == "cancelled"]
rev_conf = sum(o["total"] for o in confirmed)
avg_val = rev_conf / len(confirmed) if confirmed else 0
min_o = min(confirmed, key=lambda o: o["total"])
max_o = max(confirmed, key=lambda o: o["total"])

cust_spend = Counter()
cust_count = Counter()
for o in confirmed:
    cust_spend[o["customer"]] += o["total"]
    cust_count[o["customer"]] += 1

prod_count = Counter()
for o in confirmed:
    for item in [i.strip() for i in o["items"].split(",")]:
        prod_count[item] += 1

date_count = Counter(o["date"] for o in orders)

parts = []
parts.append("Hi Bob,")
parts.append("")
parts.append("Please find below the summary of the order data from order_summary.xlsx.")
parts.append("")
parts.append("OVERVIEW")
parts.append("--------")
parts.append("Total Orders: {} ({} confirmed, {} cancelled)".format(len(orders), len(confirmed), len(cancelled)))
parts.append("Confirmed Revenue: ${}".format(rev_conf))
parts.append("Average Confirmed Order Value: ${:.2f}".format(avg_val))
parts.append("Smallest Order: {} (${}, {})".format(min_o["id"], min_o["total"], min_o["customer"]))
parts.append("Largest Order: {} (${}, {})".format(max_o["id"], max_o["total"], max_o["customer"]))
parts.append("")
parts.append("ORDER DATES")
parts.append("-----------")
for d in sorted(date_count.keys()):
    parts.append("  {}: {} orders".format(d, date_count[d]))
parts.append("")
parts.append("TOP CUSTOMERS BY SPEND")
parts.append("----------------------")
for cust, spend in cust_spend.most_common(5):
    parts.append("  {}: ${} ({} orders)".format(cust, spend, cust_count[cust]))
parts.append("")
parts.append("MOST POPULAR PRODUCTS")
parts.append("---------------------")
for prod, cnt in prod_count.most_common(5):
    parts.append("  {}: {} orders".format(prod, cnt))
parts.append("")
parts.append("CANCELLED ORDERS")
parts.append("----------------")
for o in cancelled:
    parts.append("  {} | {} | ${} | {}".format(o["id"], o["customer"], o["total"], o["items"]))
parts.append("")
parts.append("Best regards,")
parts.append("Order Analytics System")

body = "\\n".join(parts)

eml_parts = []
eml_parts.append("From: assistant@example.com")
eml_parts.append("To: bob@example.com")
eml_parts.append("Subject: Order Summary Report")
eml_parts.append('Content-Type: text/plain; charset="utf-8"')
eml_parts.append("Content-Transfer-Encoding: 7bit")
eml_parts.append("MIME-Version: 1.0")
eml_parts.append("")
eml_parts.append(body)

eml_content = "\\n".join(eml_parts) + "\\n"

with open("testbed/emails/bob/Order Summary.eml", "w") as f:
    f.write(eml_content)

print("Email written successfully")
print("Body preview:")
print(body[:600])
'''
write_result = await write_file("./generate_summary.py", script_content)
print(write_result)

run_result = await run_command("python ./generate_summary.py")
print(run_result)

eml_verify = await read_file("./testbed/emails/bob/Order Summary.eml")
print(eml_verify)

bob_emails = await list_files("./testbed/emails/bob")
print(bob_emails)
```
